changes: Preserves and verifies both signed trust anchors through the canonical Phase-2 Stage-C v4 production call-chain.
Binds Stage-C v4 inputs and activation evidence to the exact revision, release root, and truth mode.
Makes legacy v3 deploy fail closed on full, partial, or early-crash v4 activation evidence.
Serializes v3 bootstrap and v4 activation with a shared activation lock inherited on FD 8, closing concurrent downgrade windows.
known_limitations: This release is code/readiness only; it does not stage or activate the Canonical writer, owner-gate, or passkey-v2.
No Canonical truth mode is selected by this release.
The full pinned, root-owned Stage-C updater, host mutation, and activation path remains a separate controlled cutover required before service activation.
